subject: Urgent: Oxbridge Health AZ2 throughput collapse — exec coordination and temporary failover
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@oxbridgehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T08:14:00Z
Subject: AZ2 throughput collapse — immediate help required

David —

We started seeing a sharp degradation from 07:50 UTC in AZ2. Token throughput dropped ~75%, error rate (5xx) jumped from 0.2% to ~6.8%, and median p95 latency increased from 120ms to 1.8s. This is impacting our clinical triage flows (timeouts causing retries).

Attached a quick KPI snapshot and the agent trace we ran. Can your team confirm if this is a regional hardware issue or something on our side (we haven't changed traffic patterns)? We need an immediate mitigation plan and an ETA to restore normal throughput.

Samir
Oxbridge Health — Platforms

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: AZ2 throughput collapse — immediate help required

On 2027-05-19 08:22 UTC David Kim wrote:
> Folks — forwarding customer alert from Oxbridge. Samir included KPI snapshot and traces. Quick triage please:

Triage summary (first pass):
- Observed: AZ2 pod pool experiencing sustained queue growth; GPU util per host is within normal but request latency per process is high -> points to KV cache hot-path amplification (recent model v2.3.1 kernel changes touched KV eviction heuristics).
- Correlation: We see similar (but lower amplitude) p95 shifts for a small cohort of customers starting 07:45 UTC; Oxbridge is high QPS so they amplified the effect.

Immediate mitigation plan:
1) Activate cross-region steering: route Oxbridge primary traffic to US-West (usw2) at 15% canary now, 50% in 10 min if p95 stabilizes, full in 25 min.
2) Enable prefix KV pinning for their workload to reduce eviction churn (config change on serving plane).
3) Roll back the KV eviction heuristic in a single AZ control group (if steering doesn't stabilize).

I'll open RED-4521 and start the rollback if canary doesn't show p95 < 300ms after step 1. Need approvals for priority capacity pin and a one-off customer credit (ops/finance and sales).

-Hannah
Principal SRE, Serving Runtime
Attachment: RED-4521 (ticket link)

Samir — thanks for the quick heads up and the traces. Short summary and plan: 

What we saw: rapid p95 increase and 5xx spike starting ~07:45 UTC driven by KV eviction amplification in AZ2 for high-QPS workloads.

Actions taken (now):
- Began 15% canary steering to US-West (usw2) at 11:00 UTC; telemetry shows p95 for Oxbridge requests in US-West at ~280ms and error rate back under 0.6%.
- Enabled prefix KV pinning for Oxbridge traffic to reduce eviction churn.
- Cloud infra provisioning a temporary priority pool in US-West (expected by 12:00 UTC).
- Ticket: RED-4521 created for follow-up rollback of the KV eviction heuristic if needed.

What we need from you: quick confirmation that the 15% canary traffic is handling critical triage flows without observable application errors on your side. We'll ramp to 50% in 10 minutes and full cutover if stable.

Compensation: We will apply a one-time 10% credit for May invoice; credit_approval_form.pdf attached for your records. We can also schedule an incident review with our engineering leads (proposed: 2027-05-20 14:00 UTC).

Conference bridge: https://meet.redwood.com/incident-oxbridge-0527 (joined by SRE/infra/CS).
Doc/Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4521 | https://drive.redwood.com/oxbridge/incident-20270519
